data: What is the direction of the orange line in the rightmost graph of Figure 2?

The orange line in the rightmost graph of Figure 2 represents the trade-off curve of G-BLEU and Style accuracy according to β at α = 0.7. The direction of the orange line can be determined by observing its trend across the x-axis (β). 

From the left side of the graph (β ≈ 0), the orange line starts at approximately 25 on the y-axis (G-BLEU) and decreases as β increases. At β ≈ 0.8, the orange line reaches its lowest point, around 70 on the y-axis (G-BLEU). Therefore, the direction of the orange line is downward as β increases.
